tasks.subject: Task 1: The declared boundary
tasks.description:
**Goal:** admin/pipeline/paths.ts holds every path the module names outside itself, and two tests fail if that stops being true.

**Files:**
- Create: `admin/pipeline/paths.ts`
- Create: `admin/pipeline/boundary.test.ts`
- Modify: the 14 non-test module files holding the 21 path literals
- Modify: `admin/pipeline/test-tiers.test.ts:70-76` if CORPUS_SIGNALS names change

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] paths.ts exports every one of the 21 path literals found in non-test module code
- [ ] SOURCE_PATH and SNAPSHOT_FILES keep those exact identifier names
- [ ] test-tiers.test.ts still detects a corpus-reaching unit-tier file, proved with a positive control probe, not assumed
- [ ] boundary.test.ts fails if an import leaves the module, and fails if a data/, docs/ or app/ literal appears outside paths.ts in non-test code
- [ ] data/entries/ byte-identical after a full import

**Verify:** `bun qa` green; then `bun data:import && bun qa:format && git status --short data/entries  # expect no output`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/paths.ts", "admin/pipeline/boundary.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun qa && bun data:import && bun qa:format && git status --short data/entries", "acceptanceCriteria": ["21 literals centralised in paths.ts", "SOURCE_PATH and SNAPSHOT_FILES keep their names", "tier checker proved still firing via probe", "boundary.test.ts passes", "data/entries byte-identical"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

- [ ] Neither load site uses `import … with { type: 'json' }`

**Verify:** `bun qa` green; `bun data:import && bun qa:format && git status --short data/entries  # expect no output`

- Modify: `README.md` licence section

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] No .ts file exists anywhere under data/
- [ ] data/page-index/README.md states the build method and names refs/tags/archive/v2-research-2026-09

**Verify:** `bun qa` green; `find data -name '*.ts' | wc -l` → 0; `ls data/*/README.md | wc -l` → 6

tasks.subject: Task 6: DESIGN.md — one present-tense design
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A single document states every design fact about the pipeline that is still true, so the nineteen dated specs can be archived without losing anything.

**Files:**
- Create: `admin/pipeline/DESIGN.md`
- Read: all 19 files in `docs/specs/`, plus `docs/v2/headword-design.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every design fact still true of the code appears in DESIGN.md in present tense
- [ ] No sentence describes intent, a plan, a step number or a dated decision
- [ ] bun run headword:issues produces a report whose DESIGN.md link resolves
- [ ] Each of the 19 archived specs has at least one DESIGN.md section covering its live content, recorded in a coverage table in the commit message
- [ ] Section 11 (what the pipeline will not do) is present and names at least: no vowel inference, no OCR invention, no sense renumbering

**Verify:** `bun run headword:issues && grep -c 'DESIGN.md' docs/reports/headword-issues.md` → at least 1; the link check in Step 4 prints no DEAD lines

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/DESIGN.md"], "verifyCommand": "bun qa && bun run headword:issues && grep -c 'DESIGN.md' docs/reports/headword-issues.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["present tense throughout", "coverage table for all 19 specs in the commit body", "section 11 present", "all links resolve"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

- Modify: that directory's `MEMORY.md` index
- Create: `project_pipeline_module_boundary.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Every [[link]] in a kept file still resolves after the cuts, or the sentence is rewritten

**Verify:** Count of files equals count of index lines; the dangling-link scan in Step 3 names no memory deleted by this task
